race.comment: UP THE DEN (2) led and gave nothing else a chance last start over this distance at Bordertown, the second victory in the past three outings. Beautifully drawn and carries the same weight today after the allowance. Should go forward and prove tough to reel in again. THE WIRRULLA BOY (9) has won two from two this time in work, both over 1000m at Port Lincoln. This is a different challenge but he has never raced better and apprentice Brooke King seems to have the key to the five-year-old. STREETCAR FURY (4) returned from a 24-week spell as a $1.35 favourite recently but found one better in the BM66 over this distance. Worth another chance with the blinkers going on for the first time. SURPRISATIC (7) was first-up following a seven-week break when down the track behind UP THE DEN at Bordertown last start. Has won three of six at this trip so with Callow going on it would be silly to dismiss him. SANTASTICO (8) also chased UP THE DEN in vain at Bordertown. Each-way hope.
